sources.title: Sources & method
sources.intro: Our predictions are our own: we start from public age ranges, then learn from the naps you log. We never copy another app’s output.
sources.adjustBody: We use the middle of her age range, then shift it towards her own wake windows once you’ve logged a few naps.
sources.disclaimer: Nappa tracks patterns. It isn’t medical advice — ask your health visitor or doctor if you’re worried.
